ccc: Per-individual Lin CCC using population moments across the 20 saved observation times; reference is the latent noise-free curve.
growth_time: PCHIP interpolation to 1000 equally spaced time coordinates. Maximum first derivative within the interior 90% of the full time range. Invalid if amplitude < 1% of training-observation P95-P5, maximum lies on the interior boundary, or maximum derivative is nonpositive.
aggregation: First mean individual CCC and mean absolute valid growth-time error within each repeat; then equal-weight means over 10 independent repeats. Timing MAE includes only valid predicted/latent time pairs.
uncertainty: Percentile 95% confidence interval from 10000 repeat-level bootstrap resamples; seed 73. Pale dots are repeat-level summaries.
